name: webdirlist
description: List a directory tree the same way in a browser and in node — a generated files.txt on the web, live fs in node
//exports: `.` is browser-safe and must stay that way — nothing reachable from it may import node:*. `./node` deliberately has no `development` condition: it is imported by build tooling (vite configs, scripts) that node resolves itself, and those must get the built JS rather than TypeScript source.
author: hocti
//devDependencies: Zero runtime dependencies. path-browserify-esm is gone — the library only ever needed posix path arithmetic on its own relative paths, which is src/paths.ts. No @mono/configs either, unlike most packages here: `pnpm sync-configs` *copies* the shared config in, and @mono/configs itself imports this package (assetsDir.mjs), so declaring it would be a build cycle.
